baseline_models.mechanism: The one subject brings plural persons into multiplied earthly existence and is also the directional endpoint of their passive, driven reassembly; dispersion and convergence form one governed arc.

activation_trace.role: Bringing created persons into manifest, multiplied existence supplies the outward phase of the arc.
The lower realm opposite heaven supplies the spatial field across which human plurality exists.
Driving a group from its places toward one destination supplies the convergent, Godward phase.

changed_reading.before: He created you on earth, and you will return to Him.
changed_reading.after: He multiplied and distributed you through the earthly realm, then will drive the dispersed human multitude into one Godward assembly.

baseline_models.mechanism: Three focus branches align as a cultivation sequence: seed is cast into productive ground, growth occupies that ground, and what remains after harvest is gathered. The verse can therefore image human history as divine sowing followed by harvest-like collection.

activation_trace.role: Casting seed into earth gives human origination a sowing image.
Soft, fertile, growth-bearing earth functions as the medium in which the sown plurality develops.
Crop remainder in the earth after harvest supplies the agricultural edge of final collection.
The primary image of collecting and driving a group converts the crop image into an actual gathering mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Creation and resurrection are two separate assertions.
changed_reading.after: Human proliferation in earth and Godward gathering are the sowing and harvest ends of one cultivation cycle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The cultivation baseline acquires an evaluative middle: death and life delimit the plot, living growth makes states visible under testing, and intended action is what the interval produces before collection.

activation_trace.role: Sowing in earth supplies the focus model that the context turns into a trial plot.
Driven collection supplies the endpoint at which the plot's differentiated yield is brought together.
Loss of life and power marks one boundary of the earthly growth interval.
Earth revived through rain and vegetation directly reinforces the focus ayah's cultivation mechanism.
Testing that makes a condition appear assigns disclosure as the function of earthly growth.
Intentional deed supplies the human yield made visible during the test.

structural_cues: 67:2 orders death, life, testing, and best action under the same subject who acts in 67:24.
The focus ayah's outward-to-inward spatial arc brackets the evaluative life interval introduced at the surah's opening.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies life/death, state-revealing test, deed, seed, earth, and collection; I infer that the earthly interval functions like a plot whose yield is disclosed at gathering. A live alternative is a juridical test without agricultural coloring.

changed_reading.before: Humans are sown into earth and later gathered like a crop.
changed_reading.after: Humans are sown into a bounded trial field where deliberate action reveals their condition before the whole yield is gathered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth is made traversable so people can spread through it for sustenance, while nushur names both opening/spreading and revival toward God. The focus h-sh-r then reads as the contraction that retrieves an authorized earthly expansion.

activation_trace.role: Creation with multiplication supplies the initial expansion of human presence.
Collection with directional driving supplies the final contraction toward God.
Making difficult terrain tractable enables the human dispersal phase rather than leaving earth a static location.
Walking supplies the actual movement by which created people range across earth.
Nourishing provision explains what sustains the outward earthly movement.
Opening, spreading, and branching make the contextual Godward nushur the kinetic inverse paired with focus gathering.
Revival after death secures the eschatological scope of the same expansion-and-return sequence.

structural_cues: 67:15 and 67:24 share earth as the field and repeat the directional phrase wa-ilayhi before nushur and tuhsharun.
The imperatives to walk and eat place an extended phase of mobile life between divine making and Godward return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractability, walking, provision, spreading/revival, and driven gathering; I supply the expansion-to-contraction arrow. Nushur may function only as conventional resurrection, but its spreading branch keeps the kinetic reading live.

changed_reading.before: Earth is where humans were created before resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Earth is a provisioned field for divinely enabled outward movement, followed by a Godward contraction that retrieves everyone dispersed through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding emergence is not bare biological production: it includes faculties of reception, insight, and inward response, followed by deficient gratitude. Focus gathering therefore collects equipped respondents, not undifferentiated creatures.

activation_trace.role: Creating and multiplying persons supplies the focus claim sharpened by the prior account of their equipment.
Gathering a plurality to one destination becomes the collection of morally responsive persons.
Bringing something newly into being closely restates and specifies focus creation.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies a capacity for receiving the command and warning.
Inner insight supplies a capacity for recognizing the signs attached to earthly existence.
The heart as inward heat supplies an interior site of response rather than mere sensory registration.
Recognition of gift and praise of the giver supplies the response whose scarcity makes gathering accountable.

structural_cues: 67:23 and 67:24 are adjacent, begin with the same commanded declaration, and repeat huwa alladhi followed by second-person-plural creation language.
The sequence moves from origination and endowed faculties to scarce gratitude, then restates origination and announces gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, faculties, scarce gratitude, renewed creation language, and gathering; I infer that the gathered are answerable for use of those faculties. The alternative is that the faculties serve only as gifts proving creative power.

changed_reading.before: The creator will gather the creatures He spread through earth.
changed_reading.after: The creator will gather persons whom He deliberately equipped to understand, perceive, and respond, making their earthly proliferation an accountable existence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context describes a chosen centrifugal motion: persistent disobedience culminates in distancing and flight. The passive focus gathering supplies the opposing centripetal force, so resistance can enlarge distance during earthly life but cannot cancel the final destination.

activation_trace.role: Driving a group out of its location toward a destination supplies the force that overcomes attempted distancing.
Stubborn continuation supplies duration and intentional persistence to the outward resistance.
Rebellion away from obedience gives the distancing movement its relational direction.
Drawing back and moving away supplies the centrifugal vector reversed by Godward gathering.

structural_cues: The aversion cluster in 67:21 precedes the walking contrast, the creation pair, and the gathering announcement in 67:22-24.
The focus passive and directional ilayhi oppose the agents' self-directed distancing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies persistence, rebellion, distancing, passive collection, and a Godward endpoint; I infer opposing spatial vectors. Nufur can remain affective aversion rather than literal flight, but the reversal still works relationally.

changed_reading.before: All people will eventually be assembled before God.
changed_reading.after: Even those who spend earthly life increasing their distance in defiant aversion are finally driven back along a vector they do not control.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earth changes from container to route. Two walkers occupy the same terrestrial interval but differ in posture, visibility, and alignment; the common Godward gathering turns present orientation into consequential travel rather than mere residence.

activation_trace.role: The earthly lower realm supplies the shared terrain on which the contrasted routes unfold.
A group driven to one destination supplies the endpoint that makes route and posture matter.
The repeated act of walking makes both conditions modes of passage through the earthly field.
Being inverted or cast onto the face supplies a posture that obstructs orientation while still moving.
Gentle direction toward path and truth supplies the criterion separating the two journeys.
Bodily and inward uprightness supplies stable posture for directed travel.
The straight road converts generalized earthly movement into a defined route.
Rectitude and balanced straightness reinforce alignment between posture, path, and endpoint.

structural_cues: 67:22 repeats yamshi on both sides of a balanced comparison immediately before the paired creation declarations in 67:23-24.
The focus preposition fi and directional ilayhi permit a path-to-endpoint reading without changing their ordinary spatial functions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two ways of walking, route, guidance, earth, and a final destination; I infer that earthly existence is the journey joining them. The contrast may describe present guidance without specifying stages of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Humans occupy earth until they are gathered elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Humans traverse earth in differently oriented postures toward a common compelled endpoint, so their manner of walking is already part of the return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene realizes one severe mode of h-sh-r: people do not merely arrive together but are passively cast in successive cohorts. Group formation and compelled transfer sharpen the force already latent in tuhsharun.

activation_trace.role: Collecting and driving a group to a destination supplies the focus mechanism being concretized.
Casting something until it lies at the destination supplies the coercive transfer hidden by a neutral gloss of gathering.
A group of people supplies cohort structure within the larger gathered multitude.

structural_cues: 67:8 combines a passive casting verb with kullama and a human cohort, creating repeated batch-wise intake.
The passive plural in 67:24 leaves the gathered population as patient rather than controller of the motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passive casting by cohorts and focus group-driving; I infer that the earlier scene exemplifies the coercive mechanics of gathering. It may describe only the unbelieving cohort's destination, not exhaust the gathering of everyone.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is a neutral mass reunion.
changed_reading.after: Gathering can involve externally controlled transfer in distinguishable cohorts, with the hell scene showing one destination-specific realization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The future passive of gathering is first challenged as an undated promise, then narrated as something seen rushing into nearness. The context converts grammatical futurity from remote abstraction into an approaching threshold of visibility.

activation_trace.role: Directed group collection supplies the future event whose felt distance is altered by the following sequence.
A promise bounded by time or place supplies the challenged scheduling of the gathering event.
Making a promise actual supplies the demanded transition from warning to realized event.
Direct sight and insight move the promised event across the threshold from report to encounter.
An impulsion into proximity collapses the distance presumed in the skeptical question.

structural_cues: The question 'when is this promise?' in 67:25 follows the gathering claim directly.
67:27 answers narratively with 'when they saw it near,' shifting from interrogated future to realized perception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the gathering claim, a timing challenge, promise-realization, sight, and sudden nearness; I identify the seen event with the threatened promise that includes gathering. A narrower alternative is that the pronoun points specifically to punishment after gathering.

changed_reading.before: You will be gathered at an unspecified remote future time.
changed_reading.after: The gathering is an approaching promised event whose apparent remoteness ends abruptly when it becomes near and visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps bird-wing kinetics onto human history across domains. It remains anchored in the focus multiplication/dispersion and driven gathering, while 67:19 explicitly supplies spreading, folding after spread, and divine holding. Downstream prose should present it only as a kinetic analogy, not as a lexical meaning of dhara'a or h-sh-r.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: dhara'akum and tuhsharun as outward and inward collective motions

activation_trace.role: Multiplying created persons supplies the human expansion side of the analogy.
Collecting dispersed persons supplies the human contraction side of the analogy.
Light outward spreading supplies a visible analogue for proliferated human dispersal.
Alignment on an even line shows plurality maintained in an extended, ordered state.
Folding inward after extension supplies the clearest kinetic analogue for gathering after dispersal.
Holding and restraining supplies continuous divine control across both extended and contracted states.

changed_reading.before: Human creation and gathering form a one-time start and finish.
changed_reading.after: Like the nearby visible rhythm of extension and folding held aloft, human dispersion and contraction can be imagined as two controlled configurations under one sustaining agent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because focus qul is morphologically q-w-l, not q-l-l. It remains packet-valid because the focus inventory itself supplies q-l-l as a non-dominant mapped target and 67:23 places explicit q-l-l immediately before the repeated qul. Downstream prose must retain 'say' as the translation and label carrying/rising only as a sound-and-branch resonance in the speech act.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The imperative qul at word 1, through its packet-supplied non-dominant q-l-l target

activation_trace.role: Voiced utterance preserves the ordinary command to state the proposition publicly.
The split target's carrying and rising image lets the utterance function exploratorily as lifting the claim into public hearing.
The immediately preceding paucity of gratitude supplies the low condition against which the next commanded declaration is raised.

changed_reading.before: Say is a neutral reporting frame for a doctrinal statement.
changed_reading.after: Say remains an utterance command, but it also resonates as the act that carries and raises a counterclaim against the preceding littleness of gratitude.

strongest_changes: The focus branches turn creation-in-earth and gathering into a coherent sowing-to-harvest cycle rather than two detached claims.
67:15 adds divinely enabled spreading, walking, provision, and revival, making h-sh-r the contraction after an authorized earthly expansion.
67:23 makes the dispersed humans equipped respondents whose hearing, insight, inward response, and gratitude render gathering accountable.
67:21 and 67:25-27 sharpen gathering as both irresistible against attempted distancing and suddenly near after seeming temporally remote.
summary.what_was_special: The unusually tight activation came from paired motion systems: seed and harvest within the focus, spreading and Godward revival in 67:15, aversive flight before compelled collection, and a promise that moves from questioned distance to visible nearness. The packet's split q-w-l/q-l-l inventory also preserved a contained speech-act resonance that a conservative reading would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The crop-remnant branch of h-sh-r may be evocative without licensing a full harvest metaphor by itself.
The hell cohorts concretize one coercive outcome of gathering but should not be generalized to every gathered person.
The bird-motion model is an analogy of controlled expansion and contraction, not a claim of lexical identity.
The q-l-l resonance at qul is explicitly secondary to the ordinary q-w-l morphology and should never replace it in translation.
